text:
eli: Seeing decode p95 +30% on canary after today's merge (commit 8f3d7a). KV cache evictions spiked and attention kernel fell back to generic path for long seqs. Perf CI shows decode_p95 +27% on model-x. Anyone triaging?

maria: thanks @eli — pulling profiles now. Any repro command handy?

eli: repro command:
```
./bench/decode_bench --model model-x --seq 512 --batch 8 --warmup 1000
```
I can reproduce locally in a dev cluster.

cheng: I landed a kernel selector tweak in 8f3d7a that biases attn-fusion for seq>384. There's a guard that falls back when kv_cache_misses > 0 — maybe the miss accounting is wrong and we're thrashing.

anya: perf-ci-bot reported job #5321:
```
perf_alert: decode_p95 +27.6% commit=8f3d7a
kv_evictions/sec: 184 -> 742
attn_fallbacks/sec: 2 -> 96
```

perf-ci-bot: CI regression detected: decode_p95 +27.6% (model-x), attaching flamegraph and nvprof sample.

sam: can we bisect quickly? maybe revert that selector change on canary and see.

cheng: I can open a revert PR for the selector. But I'd prefer to bisect first — fused-op scheduling fixes landed in adjacent commits too.

maria: profile snippets show time in kernel_selector::choose() and a spike of GPU memcpy waits during KV restore. Stack:
```
#0 kernel_selector::choose
#1 runtime::dispatch
#2 decode_loop
#3 nvtx::cudaMemcpyAsync
```
This suggests the selector causes incompatible kernel choices that trigger extra KV shuffles.

eli: proposed actions:
- rollback selector change from canary ASAP
- run bisection over commits 8f3c000..8f3d7a
- add targeted CI test: decode_bench seq=512 + kv_enabled

anya: +1. Can infra trigger a rollback? :thumbsup:

infra-bot: initiating rollback pipeline run-2214500000-rollback-1. ETA ~6m. Need approvals from @maria and @cheng.

maria: approving rollback. Adding CI test + alert to perf-suite.

cheng: opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345 — will add unit to prevent selector forcing fusion when kv_eviction_rate_high.

eli: after rollback we'll run a controlled bisect. I'll take the first half-range today.

sam: if bisection shows selector is culprit, patch suggestion: check kv_hotness and prefer safe non-fused kernel when kv_dirty>threshold.

anya: sounds good. Keep notes here and paste perf artifacts in the PR.

eli: on it, will post nvprof + flamegraph links when uploads finish.

maria: thanks everyone. hopefully quick rollback gets canary back to baseline.

cheng: on standby to revert more if needed.

sam: thx — will monitor canary once rollback completes.

infra-bot: rollback run-2214500000-rollback-1 succeeded. canary metrics reverting.

eli: seeing p95 back to baseline in canary dashboard. closing urgent loop, starting bisect tomorrow.

anya: great work team :rocket:
